data.title: A Day at Grandma's House
data.description: Explore fun daily activities at Grandma's house and figure out which one takes more time!

challenges.instruction: Look at these fun activities at Grandma's. Which one takes longer to do?
challenges.hint: Think about which activity you can finish super fast and which one takes a longer time.

challenges.instruction: Let's check out these two fun things to do. Which one takes more time?
challenges.hint: One of these is a quick brush, and the other takes a nice long sleep!

challenges.instruction: Which activity takes longer when you are visiting Grandma?
challenges.hint: Putting on shoes is fast, but riding in the car takes a good long while.

challenges.instruction: Look at these two yummy moments. Which one takes more time?
challenges.hint: Drinking a quick sip is super fast compared to eating a big meal.

challenges.instruction: Compare these two cozy stories. Which one takes longer?
challenges.hint: Sometimes Grandma reads books that take the exact same amount of time!
